words: abandon
əˈbændən
vt. 放弃，抛弃，遗弃，使屈从，沉溺，放纵
We have to abandon the plan.
我们必须放弃这个计划。
I will not abandon you.
我不会丢下你。
ability
əˈbɪləti
n. 能力，才干；才能
From each according to their ability, to each according to their needs.
各尽所能、按需分配。
I must take the opportunity to improve my language ability.
我要借机提升我的语言能力。
able
ˈeɪbəl
adj. 能干的，能够的
During droughts, farmers are barely able to eke out a living.
发生旱灾的时候，农民很难维持生计。
Ted was finally able to communicate his thoughts in Japanese.
Ted最终能用日语交流他的想法了。
abnormal
æbˈnɔrməl
adj. 反常的，不规则的，变态的，畸形的；n. 畸形的人
Environmental pollution is causing abnormal weather conditions.
环境污染正造成异常的天气情况。
His view on marriage is abnormal.
他的婚姻观很畸形。
aboard
əˈbɔrd
adv. 在船上，在火车上，在飞机上；prep. 在...之上
It is very dangerous to jump aboard the train when it is moving.
跳上一列正在开的火车是很危险的。
The passengers all went aboard the ship.
乘客全都登上了船。
abolish
əˈbɑlɪʃ
vt. 废止，革除，消灭；废除，取消，裁撤
We should abolish the death penalty.
我们应该废除死刑。
How can we abolish war?
我们怎样才能停止战争？
about
əˈbaʊt
prep. 在...周围，大约，有关，关于；adv. 四处，在附近，周围
The plane was about to take off when I heard a strange sound.
飞机快要起飞的时候，我听到了一个奇怪的声音。
Tom is still uncertain about whether to go to college or not.
汤姆还不清楚要不要上大学。
above
əˈbʌv
prep. 在上方，超出；adv. 在上面
John is head and shoulders above any of his classmates in French.
约翰的法文比他的同学都来得好。
It goes without saying that health is above wealth.
健康胜过财富，这件事谁都知道。
abroad
əˈbrɔd
adv. 往国外，到室外，到处；adj. 往国外的，在室外的，广泛四散的
His large income enables him to travel abroad every year.
他的收入很高，所以每年都能出国旅行。
It is not until you go abroad that you realize how small Japan is.
你出国看看，才会知道日本是多么的细小。
abrupt
əˈbrʌpt
adj. 突然的，唐突的，陡峭的，不连贯的
Bill's abrupt manner causes him to be misunderstood.
The policeman was rather abrupt with me.
absence
ˈæbsəns
n. 缺席，缺乏，没有；失神
Her absence went unnoticed until the end of the meeting.
直到会议结束之前都没人注意到她不在。
No one noticed her absence until the end of the meeting.
直到会议结束之前都没人注意到她不在。
absent
ˈæbsənt
adj. 缺席的，不在的，缺乏的，漫不经心的；vt. 使缺席
Nobody noticed that she was absent until the meeting ended.
直到会议结束之前都没人注意到她不在。
Nobody noticed that she was absent until the end of the meeting.
直到会议结束之前都没人注意到她不在。
